evidence.text: Reason for referral: Evaluation of intermittent palpitations with inreasing frequency.

Findings: Sinus bradycardia at 55 bpm. Normal axis. PR interval 172 ms, QRS 106 ms, QTc
440 ms.
Impression: Sinus bradycardia, otherwise normaltracing.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
35%. Grade 1 diastolic dysfunction. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Moderately reduced left ventricular systolic function.
